Culture.name: {=swedish}Swedish
Culture.text: {=swedish_culture_desc}A Baltic-Norse culture shaped by Christianity, old assembly law, and seafaring trade. Society is built around free farmers, tight kin networks, and local communities, with wealth flowing through ports, fairs, and merchant routes. Status shows in ships, weapons, imported cloth, and silver, while daily life is wool, timber, fishing, and seasonal work—practical, disciplined, and proud of independence.
